tie_lemmas.L0: MINSD/MAXSD returns its source operand on an equality or unordered comparison; equal finite nonzero operands have identical bits.
tie_lemmas.L1: MAXSD/MINSD with ZERO (+0.0) as src returns +0.0 on a signed-zero tie and otherwise the strictly winning VAR or +0.0; the result of a ZERO-src MAX(0, .) is >= +0.0 and never -0.0.
tie_lemmas.L2: Under IEEE-754 round-to-nearest-even, a + b is -0.0 only if a = -0.0 and b = -0.0; a - b is -0.0 only if a = -0.0 and b = +0.0; a square x * x is >= +0.0 and never -0.0; SQRT(x) on x >= +0.0 is >= +0.0.
tie_lemmas.L3: Under the pnd_LEV thick-ice guard (ELSE of h_i_1d < rn_himin .OR. a_i_1d < 0.01 at line 437), h_i_1d >= 0.1 > 0 and a_i_1d >= 0.01 > 0, so zv_ip_max at lines 464 and 471 and zhp at line 516 are strictly positive.

pnd:1398.proof: Other operand is the nonzero constant epsi10 = 1e-10 (L0).

pnd:456.proof: When dh_i_sum = dh_s_sum = +0.0, zdv_avail = -0.0 and zfr_mlt * zdv_avail = -0.0 ties with ZERO (+0.0) at maxsd@456; any zero sign of zdv_mlt is overwritten at lines 465 and 472 whose outer maxsd has src = ZERO (L1).

pnd:465.proof: In 465.min (dst = zv_ip_max - v_ip_1d, src = zdv_mlt), zdv_mlt is the ZERO-src maxsd@456 output (never -0.0, L1) and zv_ip_max > 0 (L3), so zv_ip_max - v_ip_1d is never -0.0 (L2); 465.max then clamps with src = ZERO (L1).

pnd:472.proof: In 472.min (dst = zdv_mlt, src = zv_ip_max - v_ip_1d), zdv_mlt is the ZERO-src maxsd@465 output (never -0.0, L1) and zv_ip_max > 0 (L3), so zv_ip_max - v_ip_1d is never -0.0 (L2); 472.max then clamps with src = ZERO (L1).

pnd:478.proof: Even if v_il_1d = -0.0 from line 447 ties with ZERO when zdv_mlt = +0.0, v_il_1d is read next only at lines 490 (squared, L2) and 494 (added to pos_frz >= +0.0 and clamped by maxsd@494 with src = ZERO, L1).

pnd:484.proof: zTp + rt0 = 273.0 > 0, so (zTp + rt0) - t_su_1d is never -0.0 under round-to-nearest (L2).

pnd:490.proof: The SQRT radicand is v_il_1d**2 plus a product of nonnegative terms with zdT from maxsd@484 (never -0.0, L1), so SQRT(rad) >= +0.0 and SQRT(rad) - v_il_1d is never -0.0 (L2).

pnd:494.proof: v_il_1d from maxsd@478 (src = ZERO) and pos_frz = 0.5 * maxsd@490 (src = ZERO) are both >= +0.0 and never -0.0, so their sum at maxsd@494 is never -0.0 (L1, L2).

pnd:497.proof: v_ip_1d at line 475 adds zdv_mlt from maxsd@472 (src = ZERO, never -0.0, L1), so v_ip_1d entering line 497 is never -0.0 and v_ip_1d - pos_frz is never -0.0 (L2).
